records.title:
Resolution by the Members of the Lok Sabha to commemorate the 60<sup>th</sup>
Anniversary of the first sitting of Parliament.

Madam Speaker addressed the House under 
Rule 360 regarding special sitting to commemorate the 60<sup>th</sup>
Anniversary of the first sitting of Parliament of India.

Motion for consider
the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2012 (Motion
 Adopted and Bill Passed).

Further discussion on the motion for consideration of the Chemical Weapons
Convention (Amendment) Bill, 2012 (Bill Passed).

Need to provide 
adequate wages and service benefits to the Grameen Dak Sevaks in the country.

Need to provide financial assistance to the
 Government of West Bengal to enable the State Government to re-pay the debt.

Need for payment of Royalty to Gujarat on wellhead price of crude oil and to
pay the balance amount accrued to the Government of Gujarat due to calculation
of royalty on post-discount price of crude oil.

Need to repair National Highway No.
65, construct a bye-pass on the said National Highway and a flyover on level
crossing between Rajgarh and Churu in Churu Parliamentary Constituency,
Rajasthan.

Need to ensure minimum wages and
other social security benefits to workers employed in works outsourced to
various agencies particularly in the coal sector.
Need to release the additional funds for payment of compensation to the farmers whose land has been acquired for construction of bye-pass connecting NH 218,  NH 63 and NH 4 in Karnataka.

Need to declare right bank canal of Bargi Project in
Madhya Pradesh as a National Project.

Need to provide LPG
dealership to Kerosene dealers in the country keeping in view the ongoing drive
to make cities kerosene-free.

Need to start work on doubling and electrification  of railway line between Guntur-Tenali-Repalle,  Pagdipalli-Nalgonda-Nallapadu and electrification of Guntur-Guntakal railway line under South Central Railway.
Need to accord classical language status to Malayalam.

Need to regularize the services of all the
casual announcers of Akashvani in the country.

Need to convert
level crossings as manned level crossings in Bhiwani-Mahendragarh Parliamentary
Constituency, Haryana.

Need to undertake
development and beautification of Ujjain, Chintaman and Vikramnagar railway
stations in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.

Motion regarding 41<sup>st</sup>
Report of Business Advisory Committee (Motion Adopted).

The Minister of State of the 
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation and Minister of State in
the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers laid a statement regarding status of
implementation of the recommendations contained in the 18th Report of the Standing
Committee on Chemicals and Fertilizers on Demands for Grants (2011-12),
pertaining to the Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals and
Fertilizers.

The
Minister of Law and Justice and Minister of Minority Affairs laid a statement
regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 26<sup>th</sup>
Report of the Standing Committee on Social Justice and Empowerment on Demands
for Grants (2012-13), pertaining to the Ministry of Minority Affairs.

Presentation of the
229<sup>th</sup> and 230<sup>th</sup> Reports of the Standing Committee on 
Science and Technology, Environment and Forests.

Presentation of the 163<sup>rd</sup> Report
of the Standing Committee on Home Affairs on the Working of Sardar Vallabhbhai
Patel National Police Academy, Hyderabad.

Laid the
 Action Taken Statement of Standing Committee on Social Justice and Empowerment.

Laid the Action
Taken Statements of the Standing Committee on Urban Development.

Presentation of the 14th Report of the Standing Committee on Petroleum and Natural Gas (2011-12) on Action Taken by the Government on the Recommendations contained in the 9th  Report (15th Lok Sabha) on the subject ‘Challenges of Under-recoveries of Petroleum Products.

Presentation of the
32<sup>nd</sup> to 34<sup>th</sup> Reports of the Standing Committee on Labour.

Presentation of the
22<sup>nd</sup> and 23<sup>rd</sup> Reports of the Standing Committee on Food,
Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution.

Presentation of the the 59<sup>th</sup> Report on the
subject ‘Current Economic Situation and Policy Options’ of the Standing
Committee on Finance (2011–12).

Laid the Action
Taken Statement of the Standing Committee on External Affairs.

Presentation of the
17<sup>th</sup> Report of the Standing Committee on External Affairs on Action
Taken by the Government on the Recommendations contained in the Fourteenth
Report (15th Lok Sabha) on Demands for Grants of the Ministry of External
Affairs for the year 2012-13.

Laid the 
Action Taken Statement of the Standing Committee on Energy.

Presentation of the
37<sup>th</sup> Report of the Standing Committee on Information Technology
(2011-12) on ‘The Electronic Delivery of Services Bill, 2011’ relating to the
Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Department of
Electronics and Information Technology).

Presentation of the 38<sup>th</sup> Report of the Standing Committee on
Agriculture on the Action Taken by the Government on the
Observations/Recommendations contained in the 34<sup>th</sup> Report of the
Committee on ‘Demands for Grants’ (2012-13) of the Ministry of Agriculture
(Department of Agriculture and Cooperation).

Presentation of the 60<sup>th</sup> to 63<sup>rd</sup> Reports of the Committee
on Public Accounts.

Presentation of the 29<sup>th</sup> Report
of the Committee on Private Members’ Bills and Resolutions.
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

Need to provide a
financial package for providing relief, drinking water and augmentation of
employment guarantee scheme in drought-hit areas of Maharashtra.

Need to provide additional opening at Major bridge No. 559 on
 Cuttack-Barang Section in East Coast Railway Zone.

Need to release funds under Post Matric
Scholarship scheme to facilitate eligible students at the time of admission to
higher educational institutions.

Need to rehabilitate
families displaced due to erosion of village land caused by river Gandak in
Gopalganj parliamentary constituency, Bihar.

Need to develop religious
places around Allahabad as tourist spots keeping in view the Kumbha Mela to be
held in Allahabad in 2013.

Need to stop levy
of toll tax on certain National Highways and bridges in Uttar Pradesh.

Need to make singing of national anthem daily obligatory in all primary,
secondary and higher educational institutions in the country.

Need to approve
de-notification of boundaries of Son Chiraiya Sanctuary as proposed by the
Government of Madhya Pradesh and de-notify the area under the Sanctuary.

Need to include Pakur, Dumka and Deoghar
districts of Jharkhand under Integrated Action Plan and provide all facilities
under the Action plan in these districts.

Need to
constitute a committee to ensure compliance of guidelines for issuance of BPL
card to eligible persons particularly in Sheohar parliamentary constituency,
Bihar.

Need to augment
railway services and improve passenger facilities in Amreli parliamentary
constituency, Gujarat.

Need to set up adequate
number of schools with class I to class XII in the country.

Need 
to create a new Tirunelveli Railway Division with Tirunelveli as its
headquarters.

Need to set up a
chair in the name of Mahatma Ayyankali, the great social reformer at the
Central University, Kasargod, Kerala.

Need to lift ban on transportation of construction material from Mangalore
port to Lakshadweep.

Need to take urgent measures
to check erosion of land and to provide funds for maintenance of watershed
projects in hill states particularly in Uttarakhand.

Need to look into the problems of migrants/refugees coming from Pakistan to
India.
Need to ban the import of coconut products in the country.

Introduction of
the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending)
Bill, 2012.

The Minister of State in the Minister of Railways laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained  in the 14th Report of the Standing Committee on Railways on Demands for Grants (2012-13), pertaining to the Ministry of Railways.

The Minister of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises laid the statement regarding status of implementation of  the recommendations contained in the 228th Report of the Standing Committee on Industry on ‘Revival and Restructuring of Cement Corporation of India Ltd. (CCI)’, pertaining to the Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises.
Presentation of the 10th Report of the Committee on Papers Laid on the Table and Minutes relating thereto.

Regarding grant of leave of absence from the sitting of the House to the
Members namely Shri Shatrughan Sinha, Shri D. Venugopal, Shri Madhu Koda, Shri
Dilip Singh Judev, Shri Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy and Shri Subrata Bakshi.

Secretary-General reported the messages from Rajya Sabha that Rajya Sabha
concurred in the recommendation of the Lok Sabha to elect One Member to the
 Joint Committee on Offices of Profit and One Member to the Joint Committee to
Examine Matters Relating to Allocation and Pricing of Telecome Licences and
Specturm.
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

Reference regarding
 expressing profound sorrow on tragic fire incident in cracker factory in
Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu.

Need to cancel excise duty on non-branded
jewellery.

Need to provide funds to municipalities in
the event of natural calamity to undertake relief work.

Need to conduct an enquiry into the alleged
encounter of terrorists by ATS in Aurangabad, Maharashtra and also provide
better security in the region.

Need to ensure timely implementation of MIHAN (Multi
Model Hub Airport) Scheme in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Effect of levying excise duty on
non-branded jewellery in the Budget proposals on small jewellers.

Needs to provide salary and perks to part-time reporters/cameramen appointed by
Doordarshan.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Home
Affairs laid a statement correcting the reply given on 29.11.11 to Starred
Question No. 102 by Shri Mangani Lal Mandal and Shri Syed Shahnawaz Hussain,
MPs regarding ‘Circulation of Fake Indian Currency Notes’ and giving reasons
for delay in correcting the reply.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution laid a statement regading  status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 12th report of the Standing Committee on Food, Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution  on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

The Minister of Agriculture and Minister of Food Processing Industries laid a statement regarding status of implementation of  the recommendations  contained in the 22nd Report of the Standing Committee  on  Agriculture on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Department of Agriculture and Cooperation, Ministry of  Agriculture.

Presentation of the
11<sup>th</sup> and 12<sup>th</sup> Reports of the Standing Committee on Water
Resources.

Laid the statements showing Action Taken
by Government on the observations/recommendations contained in the Action Taken
Reports of the Public Accounts Committee.

Papers laid
on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

Shri K.
Jayaprakash Hegde, member representing Udupi-Chikmagalur constituency of
Karnataka took oath in Kannada, signed the Roll of Members and took his seat in
the House.
Need to restart the rail service between Gitaldha (Bangladesh) to Kolkata.

Need to open new Kendriya Vidyalayas in
Sholinganallur and Velachery towns in South Chennai Parliamentary Constituency,
Tamil Nadu.
Need to establish an Army Unit in Odisha.

Need to rationalize the collection of toll tax and make it
transparent in the country.

Need to provide adequate compensation to farmers under crop
insurance scheme in Churu Parliamentary Constituency, Rajasthan.
Need to provide adequate power to Rajasthan.

Need to start operation of flights from Jalgaon
Airport, Maharashtra to Mumbai, Pune and Delhi.

Need
to ban illegal mining activity in riverbed of the rivers passing through
Haryana, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh.

Need
to review the proposed setting up of thermal power plants in and around Nagpur
City, Maharashtra.

Need
to declare import of hybrid cars in the country as customs-duty free.

Need to
declare the entire Odisha as drought-hit and provide adequate financial package
for the farmers in the State.

Need to make public the
details of funds received by various Non-Government Organisations in the
country.

Need to upgrade district hospitals
in the country as medical colleges to provide better health care services to
the patients.
Need to encourage building silos for storing foodgrains in the country.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Minister of State in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 9th Report of the Standing Committee on Petroleum and Natural Gas on "Challenges of   Under-Recoveries of Petroleum Products", pertaining to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
Presentation of the 28th Report of the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions.
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.
Damage caused due to cloud burst in Uttarakhand.

Need to start direct rail service from Balaghat railway station to Nagpur in
Maharashtra and Raipur in Madhya Pradesh.
Issue regarding constitution of Labour schools.

Need to give special package to farmers affected due to heavy rains in Betul
district, Madhya Pradesh.
Need to fence the Indo-Pak Border.
Regarding flood situation in Rajasthan.

Need to protect the traditional rights of
Tribals in their habitat.

Need to provide stoppage to Kanpur Shatabdi Express train at Etawah Station
in Uttar Pradesh.
Regarding the condition of National Highways in the country.

Need to streamline the procedure for providing caste certificates to the
persons belonging to SC/ST in the Chandigarh Union Territory.
Need to retrieve the Katchatheevu Island from Sri Lanka.
Regarding drought situation in Jharkhand.

Need to provide adequate compensation and medical facilities to the persons
affected by the Bhopal Gas Tragedy and remove the chemical waste.
Regarding the impact of ban on Tiger Park Tourism in the country.

Resolution regarding formulation of an
action plan to rehabilitate persons displaced from Pakistan (Discussion not concluded).
Discussion on the resolution regarding effective steps to curb rising incidents of violation of Human Rights in the Country.

Further discussion on resolution regarding setting up of a Central
University in Motihari District of Bihar moved by Shri Om Prakash Yadav on the
18<sup>th</sup> May, 2012 (Resolution Negatived).

Motion regarding 27<sup>th</sup>
Report of Committee on Private Members’ Bills and Resolutions (Motion Adopted).

Further discussion on the motion for
consideration of the Chemical Weapons Convention (Amendment) Bill, 2012
(Discussion not concluded).

The Minister of Parliamentary Affairs made a statement
regarding Government Business for the week commencing the 21<sup>st</sup>
August, 2012 and submission made by Members.

Secretary-General reported a message from Rajya Sabha that Rajya Sabha at its sitting held on the 13th August, 2012,  passed the National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bangalore Bill, 2012.

Papers laid on the
Table of the House by Ministers/members.

Situation arising out of exodus of people from the North-East Region States
from Bangalore and some other cities due to alleged threat to their security.

Motion regarding 28<sup>th</sup> and 29<sup>th</sup> Reports of Committee on
Private Members’ Bills and Resolutions (Motion Adopted).

Need to create a separate
state of Bodoland.

Need to open a Branch of Nationalised Bank in Rayagiri in Tenkasi
parliamentary constituency, Tamil nadu.

Need to review and enhance
the amount of Pension given to the beneficiaries under the Employees Pension
Scheme 1995.

Need to construct manned
railway level crossings in Kaushambi parliamentary constituency, Uttar Pradesh.

Need to construct the new building and railway
platform on the west side of Ratangarh – Sardarshahar railway line in Churu
parliamentary constituency, Rajasthan.

Need to stop the proposed
shifting of office of Geo-Spatial Centre of Survey of India from Silchar, Assam
to Shillong.

Need to speed up construction of Krishi
Vigyan Kendra in Bhind district, Madhya Pradesh.

Need
to restore the commission for agents on Public Provident Fund and postal
savings schemes.

Need to undertake doubling of railway line between Chennai and Madurai and
allocate funds for doubling of railway line between Villupuram and Dindigul in
Tamil Nadu.

Need to adopt comprehensive policy to give priority to Government
projects and to provide gas to Andhra Pradesh Power Generation Corporation
Limited at Nedunoor.

Need to change the eligibility criteria for
classification of ''minority concentrated districts'' by reducing the cut-off
mark of such population from the existing 25 per cent to 20 per cent.

Need to enhance incentives for ASHA workers engaged in Chamarajanagar
parliamentary constituency and other parts of the country during the current
financial year.

Need to include the Jat Community of Bharatpur and Dholpur in Rajasthan in the list
of Other Backward Classes Central Government List.

Need to expedite issuance of No Objection Certificates for construction of
houses in the vicinity of protected monuments in Kerala.

Intrdouction of the Constitution (One Hundred-Eighteenth Amendment) Bill,
2012 (Insertion of new article 371J).
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Power laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 19th  Report of the Standing Committee on Energy on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Ministry of Power.

The Minister of Rural Development, Drinking Water and Sanitation laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the  19th Report of the Standing Committee  on Rural Development on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.

The Minister of Tribal Affairs and Panchayati Raj laid the statement regarding status of implementation of the  recommendations contained in the 22nd  Report of the Standing Committee on Rural Development on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.

The Minister of Health and Family Welfare laid a statement correcting the
reply given on 18.05.2012 to Starred Question No. 610 by S/Shri Makan Singh
Solanki and Adhalrao Patil Shivaji, MPs regarding ‘Tobacco Attributable
Diseases’ and reasons for delay in correcting the reply.

Minutes of Committee on Absence of Members from the Sittings of the House.

records.title:
Need to evolve a
scheme for the farmers of Semi-Urban areas on the pattern of MGNREGA.

Need to take steps
to make Ganga River pollution free.

Problems faced by
distributors caused due to cease of Right Concept Marketing company (RCM).

Issue regarding
criteria for calculation of poverty line.
Need to renovate the Gopalganj Sabeya Airport in Bihar and start domestic flights.
Need to construct a bridge over Rapti river in Malhipur  in Shravasti district of Uttar Pradesh.

Need for mechanism
in place to ensure smooth supply of LPG in Meerut-Hapur Parliamentary
Constituency, Uttar Pradesh.

Need to provide financial assistance for preservation and protection of
ancient monuments in Kerala.

Need to provide
bank loan to students at lower rate of interest.

Need to increase the support price of
paddy.

Need to attach
pantry cars in Amrapalli Express and Jogbani-Anand Vihar Express trains.

Need to provide
special package for infrastructural development in Alleppey and Kollam
Districts of Kerala.

Need to ensure free of cost treatment to
the poor by the private hospitals in the country.

Need to make provision for
free entry of daily morning walkers in A.J.C. Indian Botanical Garden at
Howrah, West Bengal.

Need to construct a
railway over bridge at Kandamangalam Railway level crossing in Villupuram
parliamentary constituency, Tamil Nadu.

Need to provide
financial assistance to Government of Kerala for providing relief to the
persons affected due to the use of Endosulfan pesticide in the State.

Need to ensure proper utilization of funds under Mahatma Gandhi
National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme in Tamil Nadu.

Need to give environmental clearance to construct sluice gate in North Koel
Irrigation Project in Bihar.

Need to construct flyovers while undertaking expansion of National Highway No.
2 from four lane to six lanes in Bhadohi parliamentary constituency, Uttar
Pradesh.

Need to provide
the details of fertilizers produced and supplied to the districts of Uttar
Pradesh during 2010-11 and 2011-2012.

Need to include Chhattisgarhi
language in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.

Need to make
adequate provisions of underpass and service roads on National Highway No. 69
between Betul and Nagpur.

Need to review the opium policy and take measures for the welfare of opium
farmers.

Need to
undertake electrification of all villages under Rajiv Gandhi Grameen
Vidyutikaran Yojana in Faizabad and Barabanki districts of Uttar Pradesh.

Need
to ensure timely release of Backward Regions Grant Fund in Partapgarh
parliamentary constituency, Uttar Pradesh.

Need to augment railway services and facilities in Warangal
parliamentary constituency, Andhra Pradesh.

Need
to formulate a plan to tackle drought situation in Maharashtra.

Need to take effective measures to ban child
labour in the country.

Need to resolve the issue of seniority of Direct Recruit and
Promotee Section Officers of Central Secretariat Service.

Need to re-align National Highway No. 5 by acquisition of land on
western side of Kaza village in Guntur Parliamentary Constituency, Andhra
Pradesh.
Withdrawn of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Amendment) Bill, 2009.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Planning, Minister of State in the Ministry of Science and Technology and Minister of State in the Ministry of Earth Sciences  laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 223rd Report of the Standing Committee on Science and Technology, Environment and Forests, pertaining to the Department of Science and Technology,  Ministry of Science and Technology.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 34th Report of the Standing Committee on Information Technology on Demands for Grants (2012-13), pertaining to the Department of Electronics and Information Technology, Ministry of Communications and Information Technology.

The Minister of Coal laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations Contained in the 4th , 8th ,13th , 16th  and 21st Reports of the Standing Committee on Coal And Steel on Demands for Grants (2010-11 and 2011-12), pertaining to the Ministry of Coal.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Finances laid a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the 44th  Report of the Standing  Committee on Finance on Demands for Grants (2011-12), pertaining to the Departments of Economic Affairs,  Financial Services, Expenditure and Disinvestment, Ministry of Finance.

Presentation of the 17th Report of the Committee on Empowerment of Women on Action Taken by the Government on the Recommendations contained in the 12th Report on the subject ‘Working of National Commission for Women and State Commissions for Women’.

Laid the Study Tour
Reports of the Committee on the Welfare of Scheduled Castes and
Scheduled Tribes.

Laid the final
Action Taken Statement of the Committee on the Welfare of Scheduled Castes and
Scheduled Tribes.

Presentation of the 7<sup>th</sup>
Report of the Committee on Absence of Members from the Sittings of the House.

Secretary-General
reported a message from Rajya Sabha that Rajya Sabha agreed without any
amendment to the All India Institue of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Bill, 2012,
passed by the Lok Sabha on the 30<sup>th</sup> August, 2012.

Papers laid on the
Table of the House by Ministers/members.

The Speaker on
behalf of the House congratulated Shri Girisha Hosanagara Nagarajegowda for
winning the Silver medal at the Paralympic Games, 2012 in London.

Motion to consider
National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro-Sciences, Bangalore Bill, 2012
(Bill Passed).

Need to provide financial
assistance to Sikkim to become first fully organic farming state.

Need to ensure
safety and security of ancient manuscripts, coins and others objects of
archaeological importance housed in Gopal Naryan Library in village Bharatpura,
Patna (Bihar).

Need to implement the recommendations of
M.S. Swaminathan Commission on Agriculture and take suitable measures for the
welfare of the farmers.

Need to expedite shifting
and construction of Kendriya Vidyalaya at it's location in Bhadrak district,
Odisha.

Need to expedite gauge conversion of Palakkad-Pollachi railway
line.

Need to construct rail over bridges on level crossings in Dharmapuri

Need
to speed up the work of revival and establishment of Nalanda University in
Bihar.

Need to provide electricity connections under Rajiv
Gandhi Gramin Vidyutikaran Yojana in villages of Deoria parliamentary
constituency, Uttar Pradesh.

Need to provide
subsidy on fertilizers to farmers in the country.

Need to take suitable
measures to open Indian Statistical Institute at Giridih, Jharkhand.

Need to rollback
the increase in prices of fertilizers, extend adequate agriculture subsidy and
loan at zero percent interest to farmers in the country.

Need to mitigate the
sufferings of people residing in the vicinity of Bharat Oman Refineries
Limited, Bina (Madhya Pradesh).

Need to establish an Indian
Institute of Information Technology at Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Need to monitor utilization of funds incurred on development of Bijethua
Mahabiran Dham in Sultanpur parliamentary constituency, Uttar Pradesh.

Need to permit canal based
water supply scheme in Hoshiarpur, Punjab.

Need to provide insurance
cover to the youth falling victim to road accidents.

Need to continue operation
of Cyclone Warning Centre at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

Need to enhance the Minimum Support Price of copra and restrict
the import of palm oil in the country.

Need to sanction a new railway line between Gadwal and Macherla in Andhra
Pradesh.

The Minister of State of the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution made a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained   in the 16th and 21st Reports of Standing Committee on Food, Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution, pertaining to the  Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of   Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

The Minister of State in the Ministry of Agriculture, Minister of State in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries and Minister of State in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs made a statement regarding status of implementation of the recommendations contained in the   26th Report of the Standing Committee on Agriculture on ''Development of Abiotic Stress Resistant Crop Varieties and Dissemination of Production Enhancing Technologies -  Review of R & D and Extension Efforts in the country'',  pertaining to the Department of Agriculture Research and  Education, Ministry of Agriculture.

Laid the Final
Action Taken Statement of the Government on the Recommendations contained in
Chapter-I of the Thirteenth Report (Fifteenth Lok Sabha) of the Committee on
Empowerment of Women on the subject ‘Women Victims of HIV/AIDS’.

Presentation of the 16th Report of the Committee on Empowerment of Women on Action Taken by the Government on the Recommendations contained in the 8th Report on the subject ‘Working Conditions of Anganwadi Workers’.

Presentation of the 22<sup>nd</sup> to 25<sup>th</sup> Reports of the
Committee on Government Assurances.

of Action Taken by the Government on the Recommendations contained in the 12<sup>th</sup>
Action Taken Report of Committee on Estimates (Fifteenth Lok Sabha) on
‘Sports-Policy, Infrastructure and Training Facilities’ pertaining to the
Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (Department of Sports).
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

Need to restart Graphite Project in Palamu,
Jharkhand to address the problem of unemployment in the area.

(Railways) - 2012-13; Demands for Grants

Motion to consider National Highways Authority of India (Amendment) Bill, 2011(Bill Passed).

Need to stop recovery of debt from the

Need to speed up the work of Subarnarekha

Need
